description.zh: 云电脑模板ID列表。
description.en: The cloud computer template IDs.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑ID。
description.en: The ID of the cloud computer pool.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of cloud computer pools.

description.zh: 要查询的共享型云电脑名称，支持模糊查询。
description.en: The name of the cloud computer pool. Fuzzy search is supported.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑的授权用户ID列表。
description.en: The IDs of the authorized users of the cloud computer pool.

description.zh: 要排除的已授权用户列表。
description.en: The IDs of the users that you want to exclude from the authorized user list.

description.zh: 镜像ID列表。
description.en: The image IDs.

description.zh:
分页查询时每页行数。
最大值：100。
默认值：10。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page.
Maximum value: 100.
Default value: 10.

description.zh: 是否为多台共享类型的共享型云电脑。
description.en: Specifies whether to query multi-desktop cloud computer pools.

description.zh: 下一个查询开始的Token，NextToken为空表示没有下一个。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑所属的办公网络ID。
description.en: The office network ID.

description.zh:
共享型云电脑类型。

> 该参数暂未开放使用。
description.en:
The type of the cloud computer pool.

> This parameter is not publicly available.

description.zh:
包年包月共享型云电脑的购买时长。单位由`PeriodUnit`指定。
- 如果`PeriodUnit`为`Month`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 6
- 如果`PeriodUnit`为`Year`，该参数的取值范围：
    - 1
    - 2
    - 3
    - 4
    - 5
description.en:
The subscription duration of the subscription cloud computer pool. The unit is specified by the `PeriodUnit` parameter.

- Valid values when `PeriodUnit` is set to `Month`:

  - 1

  - 2

  - 3

  - 6

- Valid values when `PeriodUnit` is set to `Year`:

  - 1

  - 2

  - 3

  - 4

  - 5

description.zh: 包年包月计费方式的时长单位。
description.en: The unit of the subscription duration.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑关联的策略ID。
description.en: The ID of the policy that is associated with the cloud computer pool.

description.zh: 协议类型。
description.en: The protocol type.

description.zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
description.en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

description.zh: 共享型云电脑的状态。
description.en: The status of the cloud computer pool.

description.zh: 标签列表。可包含1\~20个。
description.en: The tags. You can specify up to 20 tags.

description.zh: 标签键。一旦传入该值，则不允许为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`和`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The key of the tag. The key cannot be an empty string. The tag key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. The tag key cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

description.zh: 标签值。可以为空字符串。最多支持128个字符，不能以`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或者`https://`。
description.en: The value of the tag. The value can be an empty string. The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.

title.zh: 查询共享型云电脑列表及详情
